name: Blue Mango
summary: Blue Mango is a flagship DTF breeding project built from Somango XXL and Blueberry Butcher.
breedingNotes: F2 and F3 work includes both regular and feminized directions.
Later generation work continues the DTF selection and preservation program.

name: Mango Bubbles
summary: Mango Bubbles combines the Blue Mango line with Blue Bubblegum as a distinct DTF family.
breedingNotes: The project name is locked as Mango Bubbles.
Parentage is preserved as Blue Mango × Blue Bubblegum.

name: Blue Bubblegum
summary: Blue Bubblegum is a DTF cross connecting Bubblegum Kush with Blueberry Butcher.
breedingNotes: Blueberry Butcher is the documented breeding parent on the paternal side of this cross.

name: Blueberry Butcher
summary: Blueberry Butcher is a foundational DTF parent used across multiple breeding projects.
breedingNotes: Documented parentage is Blueberry Muffin × Jack Herer.
The line appears as a parent in both Blue Mango and Blue Bubblegum.
